character_types: wife in nightgown and curly wig
visual_synopsis: A husband in a white undershirt climbs into bed next to his wife (a male actor in a curly wig, glasses and nightgown) and the two bicker lying side by side in cold blue night light. Twice the wife springs out of bed, storms to the bedroom window and shouts out of it into the dark before flopping back down, while the husband keeps arguing from the pillow with his glasses in his hand.
